verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email platform, so managing templates as code is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only a library of pre-designed templates, 'fully customizable templates' and 'dynamic content'. It never mentions HTML/MJML import, API-managed templates, variable substitution via API, or version-control workflows. Customizable templates in a UI and dynamic content are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control
